marketing_hooks.pattern: Lead with an exact dollar loss or percentage reduction before stating technical architecture.
marketing_hooks.benchmarkExample: Every unanswered call after 5:00 PM costs the average HVAC contractor $1,950 in emergency replacement revenue.

marketing_hooks.pattern: Prohibit academic AI phrases (e.g. "delve into", "testament to", "game changer"); enforce Flesch-Kincaid Grade 6-8 readability.
marketing_hooks.benchmarkExample: Picks up on the first ring 24/7, asks what is broken, collects the address, and texts your on-call tech.

cro_teardowns.pattern: Always structure prospect audits across Speed, UI/UX Taste, CRO Leaks, Schema AI Visibility, Phone Bleed, and 30-Day PM Roadmap.
Quantify monthly revenue leakage in $CAD and link directly to /contact/ with pre-scoped recovery parameters.

cloud_finops.pattern: Enforce AWS Lambda arm64 (Graviton3) + Pay-per-request DynamoDB with single-table design and PITR for 97% cloud cost reduction.
Strip whitespace, markdown comments, and repetitive system boilerplates prior to upstream LLM routing to save 15%-45% token overhead.

trade_objections.pattern: Prioritize water shutoff guidance for plumbing bursts and arcing breaker hazard isolation before calendar reservation.
Inject mandatory 45-minute travel buffers during 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM GTA dispatch windows to protect tech route reliability.

security_hardening.pattern: Isolate user inputs within explicit system delimiters and reject prompt override commands (e.g. DAN, Developer Mode) with 0 false negatives.
Mask Social Insurance Numbers and Payment Card PANs before persistence; enforce AWS Canada Central (ca-central-1) residency.
